put.description:
Sets (or replaces) the delivery URL for **all** your alert feeds.

Before saving, a **GET** request is sent to the URL — your server must respond with HTTP **200**, otherwise this endpoint returns **400**.

Alert deliveries themselves arrive as **POST** requests with a JSON array body.

The URL is stored per user: changing it here instantly affects every feed, including alerts already queued for delivery. Feeds cannot be created until the webhook is configured.

A signing secret is provisioned on the first call and returned in `secret` **once**; later calls return `secret: null`. Lost it? Use `POST /webhooks/rotate-secret`.

example.detail: Webhook URL verification failed: Expected HTTP 200, got 404.

post.description: Issues a new current signing secret. By default the previous secrets stay valid for a **24-hour grace window** so you can install the new key before removing the old one. Pass `{"immediate": true}` to revoke all previous secrets right away — use this only when a secret is compromised.

post.description:
Create a new alert feed that delivers matching real estate events to your webhook URL.

## Alert Delivery Format

Events are delivered as a **POST** request with a single JSON object body:

```json
{
  "alert_id": 100042,
  "url": "https://www.casafari.com/listing/12345",
  "address": "Rua do Exemplo 12, Lisbon",
  "location": "Lisbon",
  "sale_status": "active",
  "sale_price": 250000,
  "sale_price_psqm": 2500.0,
  "sale_currency": "EUR",
  "rent_status": "none",
  "rent_price": 0,
  "rent_period": "none",
  "rent_price_psqm": 0.0,
  "rent_currency": "EUR",
  "thumbnails": [
    "https://cdn.example.com/thumb1.jpg"
  ],
  "matched_feeds": [
    {
      "feed_id": 42,
      "feed_name": "My Alert Feed"
    }
  ]
}
```

Your server must respond with HTTP **200**. Any other status code is treated as a failure.

## Before You Start: Configure Your Webhook

Feeds deliver to your **per-user webhook URL** — one URL for all feeds, managed separately:

1. `PUT /webhooks` — set your delivery URL (it is probed with a GET and must answer 200)
2. Create feeds — this endpoint returns **409** until the webhook is configured

Changing the URL via `PUT /webhooks` instantly affects all feeds, including already-queued alerts.

## Retry Policy

If your server does not respond with HTTP 200 within **5 seconds**, delivery is retried —
**60 seconds** after the first failure, then every **10 minutes** — until the alert expires
(typically 24h). Feeds are never disabled automatically.

## Authentication of deliveries

Every delivery is signed with [Standard Webhooks](https://www.standardwebhooks.com/): each POST
carries `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature` headers. Verify the
HMAC-SHA256 signature over the raw request body using the secret from `PUT /webhooks`
(rotate it via `POST /webhooks/rotate-secret`).

post.description: Structured search of the property graph: one request body for every country. Name the places with `location_ids` (find them with `GET /v1/locations/search`), then filter by property type, price, price per m², bedrooms, bathrooms, living and plot area and features, and sort. Each result is one property, however many listings advertise it, with an opaque `prop_` id. `next` is a URL for the following page (valid for one hour, bound to your account) or `null`. Plain-language phrases go to `POST /v1/property-sourcing/searches/describe`. 100 tokens per page.

403.description: The account is not entitled to this product or country (`not_entitled`).

Each result lists the phrases it matched in `matched_tags`. Structured filters (types, bedrooms, features) belong to `POST /v1/property-sourcing/searches`. 100 tokens per page.

get.description: Homes around a point whose asking price was cut repeatedly: at least `min_price_cuts` cuts (default 1) adding up to at least `min_price_cut_pct` percent (default 5), over the home's whole time on the market or, with `since`, from that date. Search within `radius_m` (50 to 300 m) of `lat`/`lon`, in ES, FR, IT, DE, GR or AD. Each lead carries a `lead_` id, the property's `prop_` id (readable with Property Sourcing), its coordinates and its price cuts. For the next page, send only `cursor` (and `page_size`). 100 tokens per page.

data_point.description: Specifies the type of real estate data to retrieve for a given period.

date_interval.description: Defines the time interval for aggregating data points. Determines the frequency at which data is reported in the response.

date_start.title: Date Start
date_start.description: The starting date of the period associated with the passed `date_interval` field value. The format follows `YYYY-MM-DD`.

value.title: Value
value.description: The numerical value corresponding to the passed `data_point` field value for the given `date_start`.

min.title: Min
min.description: Start date in the format `YYYY-MM-DD`. If the specified date is not Monday - the closest previous Monday will be selected.

max.title: Max
max.description: End date in the format `YYYY-MM-DD`. If the specified date is not Sunday - the closest previous Sunday will be selected.

custom_locations.title: Custom Locations
custom_locations.description: List of closed polygons of geo-points to search within. Each polygon must contain at least 4 points. First and last points must match in each polygon. Maximum 4 polygons allowed.

views.title: Views
views.description: A matching listing must have every requested view, not just one.

directions.title: Directions
directions.description: A matching listing must face every requested direction, not just one.

characteristics.title: Characteristics
characteristics.description: A matching listing must have every requested characteristic, not just one.

immediate.title: Immediate
immediate.description: When false (default), the previous secrets keep working for a 24-hour grace window so you can switch the new secret before the old one stops signing; deliveries carry a signature for each active secret meanwhile. When true, the previous secrets are revoked immediately and only the new one signs — use this only when a secret is compromised.

PlatformRange.description: A range; either end may be left out.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. "ES". Needed when the location ids do not include the country's own id and the account covers more than one country.

types.description: Property type names in lower case, e.g. "apartment", "house", "villa".

page_size.description: Results per page: up to 100 (25 on Free).

tags.description: Up to 20 phrases, e.g. ["close to the beach", "sea views"]. Send tags or description, not both.

description.description: What you look for in plain words, split into phrases at commas, semicolons and "and" (at most 20).

page_size.description: Results per page: up to 100 (25 on Free).

PropertySourcingResolveRequest.description: Exactly one of url, reference or listing_id.

url.description: An http(s) link to one listing, on a portal or an agency website.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code; read from the link's domain when left out.

amount.description: Asking price; null when the price is on request.

first_seen.description: When the property came on the market for this operation.

listings_count.description: How many listings advertise it; known on a property read with expand=listings, null in search results.

matched_tags.description: The phrases of a plain-language search this property matched; null for structured searches.

total.description: How many properties match, when known.

next.description: URL of the next page (valid one hour), or null.

event.description: What changed, e.g. a new listing, a price change, a status change.

property_id.description: The property's `prop_` id, readable with GET /v1/property-sourcing/properties/{property_id}.

price_cuts.description: Price cuts over the home's whole time on the market.

price_cuts_since.description: Price cuts since the `since` date; null without it.

total.description: How many leads the area has.

next.description: URL of the next page (valid one hour), or null.

detail.description: What happened and how to fix it.

code.description: e.g. invalid_request, payment_required, not_entitled, not_found, page_depth_exceeded, request_limit_reached.

errors.description: One entry per field to fix.

HTTPBearer.description:
The API endpoints require an authentication token to be provided with each request. The token must be sent via the
`Authorization` HTTP header, containing the keyword `Bearer` followed by your authentication token.

PlatformApiKey.description: A platform API key (`cf_sk_...`, from the console at https://platform.casafari.com/console) or an OAuth access token (`cf_at_...`), sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. `X-API-Key: <key>` is accepted too.
